Ngay tại khu vực Hà Nội - KCN Phước Đông.en: Even in the region of Hanoi-KN East, the need for transportation was further noted when the Eastern Gold was being considered the new KNC with outstanding growth. That's why the demand for shipping, moving here is always being done with the rushing air.
Ngay tại khu vực Hà Nội - KCN Phước Đông.zh: 即使在河内-克伦邦东部地区,在东部黄金被视为增长显著的新的克伦邦国民委员会时,人们也进一步注意到运输的必要性。 因此对航运的需求,迁至此地,总是以急气冲天.

Theo đó, việc đóng gói hàng tại Lưu Lê s.en: As a result, the packing of packages at Liu Archive will be carried out according to a specific process, from the general survey of the size and number of goods to the selection of the package according to the properties of the goods to ensure that the quality of the goods is safe for transport.
Theo đó, việc đóng gói hàng tại Lưu Lê s.zh: 因此,刘档案馆的包件包装将按照具体程序进行,从货物大小和数量的一般调查到根据货物的特性选择包件,以保证货物质量安全运输.

Trong bất kỳ quá trình vận chuyển nào, d.en: In any process of transportation, whether close or far, safety as well as assurance of the quality of goods is always appreciated. This is also one of the quality rating criteria at a transport unit. If, after transportation, the goods remain as good as they were originally, the quality of the service here will be appreciated and vice versa.
Trong bất kỳ quá trình vận chuyển nào, d.zh: 在任何运输过程中,无论是近还是远,安全以及保证货物质量总是受到赞赏。 这也是运输单位质量评级标准之一. 如果运输后,货物仍保持原样,这里的服务质量会受到赞赏,反之亦然.

Trong quá trình vận chuyển đường dài, ch.en: During the long-distance transport process, the quality of the goods was easily altered due to long transport time along with weather conditions or traffic incidents. This was not just a waste of time, the cost even of personnel health at the transport unit.
Trong quá trình vận chuyển đường dài, ch.zh: 在长途运输过程中,由于运输时间长,加上天气条件或交通事故,货物质量容易改变. 这不仅仅是浪费时间,甚至是运输单位的人员健康费用。

Với Lưu Lê, sự an toàn của hàng hóa luôn.en: With Liu Levi, the safety of goods has always been one of the criteria that makes the quality of services here. Before receiving the delivery, the company would conduct a test to determine the quality of the goods at that time to match the quality after using service at Liu.
Với Lưu Lê, sự an toàn của hàng hóa luôn.zh: 与刘利未,商品安全始终是使这里服务质量达到标准之一. 公司在接收交货前,将进行测试,确定当时的商品质量,在刘某使用服务后与质量相符.

Với những hàng hóa dễ bị thay đổi chất l.en: With the easily modified goods, Liu Liu Liu will have a specialized preservative method to restrict the minimum rate of goods that have been turned to substances that reduce quality. This, however, would have sub-records so that customers could themselves apply the preservative methods to their goods or use the conservation services at Liu.
Với những hàng hóa dễ bị thay đổi chất l.zh: 有了易于改造的商品,刘刘将采用专用的防腐方法,限制被转化为降低质量物质的商品的最低率. 然而,这将有子记录,使顾客自己可以对其货物采用防腐方法或使用刘氏的养护服务.

Với định hướng phát triển kinh tế hiện n.en: With the current economic development orientation, transport plays a non-little role in accelerating growth. Because in order for the market economy to be secured, shipping in general and exporting goods to areas in particular is a great need for this period.
Với định hướng phát triển kinh tế hiện n.zh: 以目前的经济发展为导向,交通运输在加快增长方面发挥了非小的作用. 因为为了确保市场经济的安全,这一时期非常需要一般的航运和向特别地区出口货物。
